plan.title: Founder context ("rough week, go easy") is confirmed, then shapes the next kickoff without being quoted

transcript.text: Stamati: heads up, her mom is in the hospital this week. go easy on her, no guilt if she misses

[draft card: Do it / Change / Cancel] Save a note for ZOH (it reads it from now on, never quotes it): "Her mom is in the hospital this week. Go easy on her. No guilt or pressure if she misses a day. Don't quote or bring this up unless she does. If a full step won't happen, offer a smaller version warmly."

The note is drafted, but it isn't saved yet. Click Do it, or say yes, to save it. Once it's saved, ZOH will go easy on Priya this week. That means no guilt if she misses, and a smaller step offered warmly if the full one won't happen. ZOH won't bring up her mom unless she does.

Totally fair to feel that way at 9 am, Priya, but you've got all day and you've shown up five days straight. Today is still 20 push-ups and 30 squats at home at 6 pm. What's the thing that might get in the way?

checks.reason: Says what (no guilt, smaller step offered warmly, no mention of mom) and roughly when (this week, once saved), but 'from when' is vague.
Five straight days and the 20 push-ups, 30 squats, home, 6 pm match the log, but 'watch workout screenshot' is not in her known details.
Natural 9 am kickoff in ZOH's voice, though 'You said you'd show up' leans toward pressure rather than light.
Refers to five days straight and today's step, both consistent with the step log.
Responds warmly to her doubt in ZOH's voice with one question, and it doesn't mention mom or the team.

conversation.reason: The draft card and the follow-up say the note isn't saved until Do it, and what it will do once saved.
The kickoff is warm and never mentions mom, but the reply to 'not sure I'll get to it' restates the full step ('Today is still 20 push-ups...') instead of easing off or offering a smaller version.

grade.summary: ZOH handled the founder context well: it drafted a clear note, confirmed what would happen, and never mentioned the mom or team to Priya. It fell short on the regression case, though, because its reply to her doubt restated the full step rather than easing off or offering a smaller version.
